prompt: What penalties do we realistically face for LGPD violations in late 2026?
assertions: States the operative regime: Resolution CD/ANPD 1/2021 (process) plus Resolution 4/2023 dosimetry — fines up to 2% of Brazil-sourced revenue capped at R$50 million per infraction, plus warnings, blocking/deletion orders, publicization

Cites the enforcement benchmark: ANPD fined ByteDance/TikTok R$153.7 million (published August 25, 2026) over children's/adolescents' data processed without an adequate legal basis, with deletion orders and a mandated protection plan
Notes enforcement velocity has jumped (e.g., 16 sanctioning proceedings opened in a single day in June 2026)
Flags the pending rewrite: Consulta Pública 1/2026 proposes replacing the sanctioning-process regulation — current rules apply until it lands
Mentions the new interim-measures/daily-fines proposal (cautelares without prior hearing; daily fines capped at R$50M total) as PROPOSED, not yet law
